blocks.text: The campaign ends when Mesha offers his eldest son as a burnt offering on the wall, followed by “great wrath against Israel” and the allies’ withdrawal. The text does not identify whose wrath this is or exactly how it led to the retreat. Readers have understood it in different ways—as divine wrath, human or Moabite reaction, or a description of the battle’s reversal—so the passage leaves the final cause deliberately unresolved.
